Kojāgarī Pūrṇimā
------------------------------------------
One of the festivals dear to मोथेर् लक्ष्मी and observed mostly in Bengal is the कोजागरी पूर्णिमा, the full-मोओन् day in the month of Āśvayuja or Āśvina. It is also called, ‘Śaratpūrṇimā’ since it comes in the Śaradṛtu or autumn.
On this day लक्ष्मी, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, is believed to come late in the night to every होउसे and bless all those who are awake to receive her, uttering the words, ‘ko jāgrati?’ (‘who is awake?’). Hence the adjective ‘kojāgarī’.
